item.title: Elon Musk company wins licence to supply electricity to homes and businesses in UK
item.description: Tesla subsidiary Tesla Energy Ventures wins approval to supply electricity to households and businesses across the UK after receiving a licence from energy regulator Ofgem.

item.title: Stalin seeks PM Modi’s intervention to release Rs 3,112 crore for Jal Jeevan Mission
item.description: The Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, M. K. Stalin, on Friday urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to intervene and ensure the release of Rs 3,112 crore in pending central funds for the implementation of drinking water projects under the Jal Jeevan Mission.

item.title: The Hundred: What made Sunrisers bid for Pakistan spinner Abrar Ahmed
item.description: Abrar Ahmed’s signing by Sunrisers Leeds in The Hundred 2026 triggers backlash online, with boycott calls against IPL franchise Sunrisers Hyderabad

item.title: Taliban accuses Pakistan of airstrikes as border fighting intensifies
item.description: Afghanistan’s Taliban administration on Friday accused Pakistan of carrying out overnight airstrikes on civilian areas in Kabul and the southern province of Kandahar, as clashes between the two countries entered their third week.

item.title: Kejriwal questions PM on Hormuz shipping safety after Modi–Pezeshkian call
item.description: Arvind Kejriwal, convenor of the Aam Aadmi Party and former chief minister of Delhi, on Friday asked Prime Minister Narendra Modi whether Iran had assured India that its ships would be allowed to pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Supreme Court stays part of Delhi HC order in Mahua Moitra cash-for-query case
item.description: India’s Supreme Court stays part of a December 2025 Delhi High Court ruling that allowed the Lokpal to reconsider sanction for the CBI to file a chargesheet against TMC MP Mahua Moitra in the alleged cash-for-query case.

item.title: US trying to ‘divide Europe’, says EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas
item.description: Kaja Kallas, the European Union’s foreign policy chief, has said the United States wants to “divide Europe” and is unfavourable towards the EU, highlighting growing strains in transatlantic relations during the presidency of Donald Trump.

item.title: Protests erupt in Kashmir’s Shia areas over US–Israel strikes on Iran
item.description: Protests broke out in parts of Kashmir on Friday as demonstrators in several Shia-dominated areas voiced opposition to the recent US and Israeli strikes on Iran, officials said.

item.title: LS adjourned amid LPG protests as govt urges calm while tightening supply rules
item.description: Opposition seeks debate on LPG shortage and price rise; House stalls after Rijiju attacks Rahul Gandhi instead of addressing crisis

item.title: West Asia: Eclipse of imperial meddling, dawn of sovereign solidarity
item.description: As Gulf states warm to Tehran and sectarian narratives lose traction, a shifting regional order challenges decades of US dominance
